items.title: Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP)' (PDF 14): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: TCP/IP ka matlab hai Transmission Control Protocol aur Internet Protocol. Yeh Internet par istemal hone wala main (sab se ahem) protocol hai. TCP reliable (bharose wali) data delivery yaqeeni banata hai. IP data ki addressing (pata dena) aur routing (raasta chunna) sambhalta hai. Dono mil kar devices ke darmiyan communication mumkin banate hain. Yeh taqreeban har network mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: IP parcel par pata likhne aur raasta chunne jaisa hai; TCP check karta hai ke saare parcel pohanch gaye aur sahi tarteeb mein hain, aur jo gum ho jaye use dobara mangwata hai.

blocks.prompt: TCP aur IP ke kaam mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: TCP data ki bharose wali delivery yaqeeni banata hai; IP data ka address aur raasta (routing) sambhalta hai.

items: TCP/IP: Internet ka main protocol; TCP = bharose wali delivery; IP = addressing aur routing.
